result.summary: No critical breakage found. Page renders cleanly overall, with 1 major content concern about the '-100%' badge and 2 minor polish issues around carousel clipping and inconsistent time formatting.

issues.description: Discount badge on second Popular card shows '-100%' which looks like an erroneous or placeholder promotion value
issues.suggestion: Verify promotion logic and display intended discount text, e.g. '-20%' or 'Free delivery', instead of '-100%'

issues.description: Third card in 'Fastest near you' is abruptly clipped mid-card at the right viewport edge, cutting the title to 'Trattoria Piccol' and clipping delivery price
issues.suggestion: Add proper carousel end padding and snap/peeking so cards are not cut mid-text, or ensure horizontal scroll affordance is clear

issues.description: Delivery time badges use inconsistent formatting: '15-25 min' vs '20-30 min' vs '20-30 min' with different dash and spacing
issues.suggestion: Standardize to a single time-range format with consistent dash and spacing across all badges
